stage: frozen before clean or retarget measurement
FOOT_TOLERANCE_formula: 0.01 + 0.0001 * setup distance from hip origin to ankle point (world units), per verify.ts
supportSpanDriftBound: At a constant plant anchor, pairwise displacement is at most twice the existing foot landing tolerance; report horizontal and vertical span ranges and do not count absent spans as pass.
mapChoice: source-map.json is the exact corpus map. Trial map changes only leg_r and leg_l bend from absent/default rest to free, under the documented frontal 2D policy frozen in map-diff.json. Hinge direction remains unverified; all numerical bars unchanged.

precheck.frames: first 30 consecutive acquisition frames, unchanged coordinates/times; clean this subset independently
required: named map/rig points and chains resolve
precheck.onRefusal: Record any subsequent refusal without inventing constraints, caps or ranges.

machineAcceptance: rig-c gate green through official development runtime
all owned LAND checks within pinned tolerances
nonempty measured support spans and recorded actual planted-ankle drift; SKIP is not pass
limits: No camera track or camera assumption is fabricated. Fixed-camera interpretation is recorded if emitted.
No stance tolerance, leg-scale clamp, hand contact, rotation range, alternate drawing, or replacement rig is guessed.
Machine-green alone gives overall PARTIAL while owner hand acceptance is pending.
profileReason: spine is the documented accepted-v3 core control profile; validity gate includes official round trip. Renderer/archetype exclusions remain explicit, not treated as pass.
